snippet.title: Game Trailer - Forgotten Towns
snippet.description:
Lot has happened past month, the game made massive improvements in art and gameplay.

Make sure to check the links in the description for more information.
Build a flourishing settlement above a dangerous cave system. Explore unique biomes, manage happiness and grief, invite traders, defend against invasions, train soldiers, recruit heroes, defeat world bosses, and prepare to dig into the depths below.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818290/Forgotten_Towns/

Check out the wiki and patch notes!
https://taffeesoftware.nl/forgotten-towns.php?lang=en
